title: The best wireless earbuds that guarantee superior music and voice call experience
snippet:
Although we loved the flexible, packable neckband design of the House of Marley Smile Jamaica, the included ear tips were too small for even our panellists with medium-size ear canals, so a lot of people won’t be able to get a good seal. The poor fit might explain why the sound lacked the ability to reproduce low notes and had blurry mids and sizzling highs in our tests. [...] Several new pairs of wireless earbuds have been announced including Klipsch’s leather-clad R5 neckband-style earbuds and the “earth-friendly” House of Marley Uprise earbuds, which are sweat-proof and weather resistant up to IPX5.
